source_text: Recensentur sortes Ruben Gad Manasse. Qui iam acceperunt adiuvent fratres. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: Are-reviewed lots of-Reuben Gad Manasseh. Who already received let-them-help brothers. Amen.
pass_b_english: Reuben, Gad, and Manasseh’s lots are recalled. Those who already received must help their brothers. Amen.
anf_compare: no ANF for Rufinus Joshua homilies; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105
